about_the_game:
MONSTER WAR is a game at the crossroads of Clicker and RPG genres.

MONSTER WAR can't be called only a clicker or only a role-playing game. It is a game that incorporates iconic elements of both genres, and incorporates systems, ideas, and imagery never before seen in any clicker game.

The game has an online features: you can trade with other players, chat in-game, use promo codes and get many other bonuses - and all your progress is always saved in the game's database, provided by BMBK Games for you.

You can buy and create gear that you can wear to give your playtime extra efficiency: chances of resource drops, increased damage from critical hits, reduced stamina consumption, a percentage bonus to the basic rewards you receive, and so on...

You can master the following types of skills:
- trade skills for efficiency and economy in your future upgrades;
- combat skills to increase your damage output;
- gathering skills to get more useful resources.

You can craft potions in Alchemy from the organs of defeated enemies: their use will give you positive effects, but will slow down your progression for a while - and it is up to you to decide how and with what to combine these potions.

In MONSTER WAR you can progress endlessly: you have the ways and reasons to grow, to learn and to compete.

short_description: Become a monster slayer that will be reckoned with! MONSTER WAR is an RPG clicker game that will be its new milestone. It is a game about a devout world endlessly tormented by monsters. In this game, you can kill thousands of enemies, craft equipment, brew potions, and compete with other players...
